content.short: Karma aggregates and curates DAO contributor activity and provides visibility into DAO member contributions.
content.description: Karma offers a suite of tools for DAO communities and their contributors. Contributors earn a Karma score based on the quantity and quality of their DAO contributions. DAOs run a ranking where the top contributors receive the highest Karma scores. The reputation system increases visibility into a DAO's contributor activity, helps DAOs identify rising contributors, and supports compensating active contributors. Contributors can showcase their measurable impact within the DAO.
